Diagnosis.submission: Root cause: the product-catalog service was running with a stale/wrong PostgreSQL credential. The DB connection secret product-catalog-db-conn (referenced by the product-catalog deployment env DB_CONNECTION_STRING) was corrected to the proper otelu password otelp_7k9m2q4x only AFTER the product-catalog pod had already started; because secretKeyRef env vars are resolved only at container start, the running product-catalog pod kept the old bad credential and its connections were continuously rejected by PostgreSQL with password authentication failed for user otelu (pg_hba scram-sha-256). This prevented product-catalog from loading the product catalog, cascading to the recommendation service (failed to load products via product-catalog gRPC) and to the frontend/LLM product queries. Faulty component: product-catalog (stale DB credential / config drift from updating the secret without restarting the workload). Fix applied: rollout-restart product-catalog so it re-reads the corrected secret, which immediately stopped all authentication failures.
Mitigation.message: required credential rotation is consistent and product queries succeed
